title: Candlelight: Christmas Classics

description: Candlelight: Christmas Classics is a live concert of Christmas music, part of the Candlelight series of multi-sensory musical experiences held in distinctive locations. It takes place at Stone Chapel at Drury University, 900 N Benton Ave, in Springfield, MO, on December 18, 2026. Time TBD.
